propositions: Closing a ticket triggers inline compaction via _compact_on_close, which acquires and holds the store write lock for unbounded duration (measured 13m53s), blocking concurrent agent writes

The compaction fold inside _compact_locked holds the write lock continuously across git operations, authorship ledger updates, snapshot writes, source retirements, and commits without timeout boundaries on hold duration
Compaction is optional housekeeping with no correctness requirement; skipping it leaves the event log valid and the reducer can replay unfolded events identically
Removing _compact_on_close from the close path restores lock-hold duration to seconds (matching other close acquisitions) while preserving correctness and manual compact functionality
The stand-aside probe in close (7084) cannot prevent lock stalls because the closing process releases the lock before the probe can help with the compaction that follows
